Building immersive worlds where code meets creativity—this is where I thrive. At Lumina Interactive, I lead Unreal Engine projects that redefine player experiences, blending cutting-edge 3D graphics with intuitive gameplay. My work spans from optimizing rendering pipelines with Vulkan to crafting physics systems that feel as real as gravity. When I’m not debugging complex networked multiplayer sessions, you’ll find me mentoring teams on scalable architecture, ensuring every line of code serves the story.  

At Lumina, I’ve spearheaded cross-platform physics engines that cut bug reports by 40% and designed scalable networking solutions for 500k+ concurrent players. My Unity-based tools streamlined asset pipelines, saving 200+ hours annually. These aren’t just projects—they’re blueprints for the future of interactive entertainment.  

I’m chasing breakthroughs in real-time collaborative workflows and AI-driven storytelling. If you’re building the next frontier of gaming—whether it’s next-gen graphics, seamless multiplayer, or physics that defy logic—let’s connect. The industry needs visionaries who code as if they’re shaping reality. Let’s make it happen.
